name: GCP Credits
author: adi-IL
description: Google Cloud credit balances in the Omarchy bar. The billing console exposes issued credits, remaining value and percent remaining through a browser-only private API, so this plugin drives an isolated headless Chromium cloned from your own Chromium profile and shows what the credits page shows.

barWidget.description: Usable Google Cloud credits from the billing console, with a per-credit panel

schema.label: Amount format
schema.description: compact shortens large amounts (INR 12345 becomes 12.3k, USD 1250 becomes 1.25k) so several currencies still fit in the bar. exact always prints the full number.

schema.label: Expired and used credits
schema.description: Whether the panel lists credits that are expired or fully spent.

schema.label: Billing account id
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to the open billing account from `gcloud billing accounts list`.
